sources.name: Ambulance Quality Indicators Data 2026-27
sources.geography: Eleven NHS ambulance services in England
sources.usage_limit: Ambulance-service aggregates reflect incidents, categorisation, demand and operational systems; they are not journey-time or service-availability measurements for an individual parcel.

sources.name: Ambulance Quality Indicators landing page and time series
sources.geography: England, regions and individual ambulance services
sources.usage_limit: The landing page supports definitions and revisions; it does not provide parcel-level response probability or guaranteed travel time.

sources.name: Ambulance management information
sources.published_or_current: Category 2 ICB and June handover files published 9 July 2026
sources.geography: Integrated Care Boards, ambulance trusts and receiving NHS trusts
sources.usage_limit: Management information receives limited validation and provider or ICB averages cannot be assigned to households or parcels.

sources.name: A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions 2026-27
sources.geography: NHS providers and systems in England
sources.usage_limit: Provider activity and waiting measures describe service workload; provider location or system totals are not evidence of emergency access at a parcel.

sources.name: A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions landing page
sources.usage_limit: Historical monthly estimates before June 2015 and organisation-level aggregates require their documented caveats; no parcel inference is allowed.

sources.name: Corridor Care urgent and emergency care daily situation reports
sources.usage_limit: The new management collection has minimal validation, variable submission completeness and evolving guidance; it cannot score a parcel or predict an individual's care.

sources.name: Urgent and Emergency Care Daily Situation Reports
sources.usage_limit: SitRep returns are operational snapshots affected by reporting coverage and definitions; they do not establish parcel-level resilience or access.

sources.name: Critical care and General & Acute Beds UEC SitRep 2026-27
sources.usage_limit: Bed capacity and occupancy are provider operational measures, not local hazard exposure, guaranteed capacity or parcel service quality.

sources.name: Acute discharge situation report
sources.published_or_current: 2026 monthly and weekly discharge files available
sources.usage_limit: Hospital discharge flow reflects clinical and care-system processes; it cannot be used as a parcel safety or accessibility score.

sources.name: NHS 111 online statistics
sources.usage_limit: Online journeys reflect user access, behaviour and triage outcomes; they are not confirmed diagnoses, local incidence or parcel conditions.

sources.name: Integrated Urgent Care Aggregate Data Collection 2026-27
sources.geography: England integrated urgent care providers and systems
sources.usage_limit: Provisional aggregate activity depends on service configuration and reporting; it cannot be transferred to a parcel or individual emergency outcome.

sources.name: Provisional Accident and Emergency Quality Indicators for England May 2026
sources.usage_limit: HES-derived provider indicators are provisional and depend on coverage and coding; they do not measure emergency risk or response at a parcel.
